purpose.zh: 一只手撑地时练身子转过去，侧腰和肩膀都有劲
purpose.en: Turning your body while one hand holds you up builds the sides of your waist and your shoulders.

text.zh: 一只手撑地，一条腿从身子下面穿过去
text.en: Push through one hand and thread one leg under your body

text.zh: 四点撑，膝盖离地一点开始。
text.en: Start on hands and feet, knees just off the floor.

text.zh: 转身时撑地的手使劲推，屁股别落地。
text.en: Push the floor away with your support hand as you turn. Hips stay up.

text.zh: 左腿穿一次、右腿穿一次，合起来记 1 下。
text.en: Thread each leg through once, and that pair is one.

commonErrors.en: Sitting your hips down on the floor.

cautions.zh: 一只手撑全身转过去，手腕先活动开，刺疼就停
cautions.en: One hand holds you as you turn. Warm up your wrists first and stop on sharp pain.

cautions.zh: 转不过来就先只做熊爬撑住
cautions.en: Can't turn through yet? Just hold the bear position.
